text_block_list.text:
It's the race of the century: the Emperor
vs the
Beast. Speculation is rampant as
to who will come
out on top.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The competitors themselves are no
exception.
Sparks fly as they size each
other up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Will the Emperor triumph or will the
Beast devour
her whole? The crowd goes
wild as the race
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
